The '''Thermal Devastator''' was a [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]]-like incendiary explosive which was in use during at least [[3630 BBY]]. Feared among the galaxy for its potency, the Devastator's effects were twofold: first lighting the immediate area around it ablaze before emitting a concussive wave which launched enemies through the air.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=ability|Thermal Devastator}}</ref> The [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] utilized Thermal Devastators while defending against a series of [[Uprisings against the Eternal Alliance|uprisings]] which occurred following the fall of the [[Eternal Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The most powerful and feared explosive in the galaxy, the Thermal Devastator emits an incendiary concussive wave that sets enemies ablaze. While the initial impact sears foes in an all-consuming conflagration, the follow-up wave of force launches them through the air with bone-shattering force.|"Thermal Devastator" ability description|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Thermal Devastators were added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of game update 5.0, the first of the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' expansion. They can be collected by the player from Destroyable Crates as a temporary ability during Uprising missions.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
